'''Dress gloves''' were a type of [[Glove/Legends|glove]]. [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] wore [[Color/Legends|black]] dress gloves while attending a [[Squid Lake/Legends|performance]] at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Star Wars Character Encyclopedia" />
